verses.english: An assembly of the dregs and an assembly of the cream.
And what is an assembly of the dregs?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, yassaṁ parisāyaṁ bhikkhū chandāgatiṁ gacchanti, dosāgatiṁ gacchanti, mohāgatiṁ gacchanti, bhayāgatiṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: An assembly where the mendicants make decisions prejudiced by favoritism, hostility, stupidity, and cowardice.
This is called an assembly of the dregs.
And what is an assembly of the cream?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, yassaṁ parisāyaṁ bhikkhū na chandāgatiṁ gacchanti, na dosāgatiṁ gacchanti, na mohāgatiṁ gacchanti, na bhayāgatiṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: An assembly where the mendicants make decisions unprejudiced by favoritism, hostility, stupidity, and cowardice.
This is called an assembly of the cream.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imāsaṁ dvinnaṁ parisānaṁ yadidaṁ parisāmaṇḍo”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two assemblies is the assembly of the cream.”
